title: github.com/streadway/amqp is deprecated
summary: The latest github.com/streadway/amqp module declares: "Consider using the github.com/rabbitmq/amqp091-go package instead."

constraints: Keep go.mod and go.sum consistent: after the change no package should still require github.com/streadway/amqp, directly or through a replace directive.
Check github.com/rabbitmq/amqp091-go for API differences before switching; it may not be a drop-in replacement for every github.com/streadway/amqp call.

steps.title: Replace the deprecated module
steps.instructions: Replace the github.com/streadway/amqp requirement with github.com/rabbitmq/amqp091-go (`go get github.com/rabbitmq/amqp091-go@latest`), then run `go mod tidy`.

steps.title: Migrate imports and calls
steps.instructions: Update imports and calls of github.com/streadway/amqp in the reported files to github.com/rabbitmq/amqp091-go.

verification.purpose: Build and test every package without the deprecated module.

verification.command: go mod tidy && git diff --exit-code go.mod go.sum
verification.purpose: Confirm go.mod and go.sum are tidy after the replacement.
